definitions.cutoff: completed matches strictly before cutoff_date only
definitions.frequency: rate = count / applicable n; null when n = 0, never padded
definitions.h2h: prior main-division league meetings only, current home team's W/D/L perspective
definitions.result_codes: FT/HT 1/X/2 are historical match home/draw/away; W/D/L are the named team's perspective
definitions.streaks: most recent completed match backwards; 0 when the latest match does not satisfy

note: Historical frequencies describe past matches; they are not calibrated chances.
